scope: Static known CLI registration records and dispatcher; not an exhaustive proof against all dynamic commands
findings: Known OS records expose thread, mem, spi and reg.
mem at 0x80112fac displays allocator statistics; it is not a RAM loader or arbitrary execution command.
thread at 0x801131a8 includes state/priority mutations; it is not a verified RAM boot path and was not executed.
The reboot builtin posts event 2 at 0x80112368; it was not executed.
No verified software-only candidate loading/execution route was established by this inspection.
Bootloader TFTP/RAM menu presence remains separate from runtime access.

Follow-up: reg forcibly maps input to (input & 0x0ffffffc) | 0xb0000000. It cannot directly read/write RAM; a mismapped live read was rejected and that method retired. See ../ssid-airplay/runtime-state-query-rejected.json.
